content:
After just reporting that the AirPods Pro 3 has dropped to one of its lowest prices ever, the fall Prime Day deals are now pouring in for the latest batch of Mac products. We're seeing the entire M6 Mac mini lineup hit all-time low prices with savings of up to nearly $150, while the 2026 Mac Studio is also seeing a discount of close to $200.

These deals also include $200 off most M5 MacBook Air models, $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continuing, the first discount on Apple's newly launched minimalist full-character Magic Keyboard, and rare price cuts on the Magic Mouse.

For those looking to pick up a MacBook, the fall Prime Day has brought the lowest prices in months for the Apple M5 MacBook Air lineup. Amazon is currently offering $200 off nearly every configuration, with most models also available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (original price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (original price $1,999)

Amazon brought some very notable discounts to Apple's brand-new Mac mini lineup this morning. From the entry-level M6 configuration all the way up to the high-end M5 Max model, we're now seeing discounts of up to $149, marking the lowest prices ever:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (original price $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (original price $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (original price $1,699) — all-time low

On top of these deals, the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM has also hit its lowest price ever, with Amazon cutting the pricing by $199 — the best deal since it went on sale last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (original price $2,499) — all-time low

Although we're still waiting (and hoping) for more MacBook Pro deals, Amazon is still offering an attractive $500 discount on this upgraded 2TB model — a price that's actually $100 cheaper than the original MSRP before the price hike:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (original price $3,199)

Beyond that, we've also spotted solid discounts on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, both the black and white Magic Mouse are seeing rare deals with up to nearly 25% off the asking price, plus the first discount on Apple's all-new Magic Keyboard featuring the minimalist full-character design that launched earlier:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (brand-new 2026 model) $80 (original price $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse White $60 (original price $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse Black $80 (original price $99)
